title: The impact of social media usage frequency on air travel behavior: An empirical analysis from China
core_idea: Investigate how the frequency of social media usage affects Chinese residents' air travel behavior by integrating the Theory of Planned Behavior and Media System Dependency theory, using 2022 CFPS data and applying logit regression, instrumental variable analysis, mediation analysis, marginal effect analysis, and Blinder–Oaxaca decomposition to explore behavioral mechanisms and heterogeneity.
tldr: Study aims to assess the relationship and underlying mechanisms between social media usage frequency and air travel behavior in China using TPB and MSD frameworks and multiple empirical methods on 2022 CFPS data.
